intro.fallback: As Asuma and Kazuma continue their bout, Sora continues to fight against the Konoha shinobi in his three-tailed form.

Naruto attempts to stop him, but the anger and hatred of the Nine-Tailed Fox's chakra sealed within Sora resonates with the real fox sealed inside Naruto, causing Naruto to instantly transform into his one-tailed form.

Yamato attempts to use his Hokage-Style Sixty-Year-Old Technique — Kakuan Entering Society with Bliss-Bringing Hands to suppress Naruto's transformation, but to no avail, as it is Sora's chakra that is causing Naruto's...

outro.fallback: The sight of Naruto stabbing himself awakens a part of Sora inside his four-tailed form, where he contemplates on his being alone, watched on by adults who despise him.
He then hears the sound of Naruto's voice calling out to him.
